_doc: Proposed first Gold Set (2026-09-05): greedy class cover over cold-read-B.json, 6/6/7 per volume, forced structural leaves (blank, title, Approbatio, Psalter, table, index, rubric) + skew/warp extremes. Jarvis reads, Sir corrects and validates in the Plate Tool.

leaves.kind: PRELIM prose 'TO THE READER' continued; LEFT citation column, RIGHT summaries; no page number

NT BOOK OPENING (Mark): CR at gutter, ornament, 3-line BT, CH, AR with right summary, 6-line woodcut initial, VN column LEFT separated by a vertical rule, left citations, right notes; LAST LINE CUT BY THE SCAN
NT: annotations above rule, CHAP. III, argument, 5-line woodcut initial, verses VN right; LITURGICAL rubric in left margin; frame rule right

NT John 20: CR at gutter (left), head carries RH + PN + 'HOLY weeke' liturgical marker; SPACED-CAPS emphasis in verses; VN LEFT with a rule; liturgical rubrics right; two-line annotation header; signature 'Mm ij'
NT Acts 28 END: verses with a long italic quotation, right citation column, frame rule; rule; two-line annotation header; AN with left summaries; catchword carries a numeral; blank below

PRELIM/END-MATTER BOUNDARY: two-column lectionary table ('EPIST. AND GOSPELS'), rule, four-line display title 'AN AMPLE AND PARTICVLAR TABLE…', then two-column index begins with letter head 'A' and a woodcut initial; signature 'Bbbbb iij'
Genesis 36 plain scripture: topical RH at gutter ('Iacob.'), VN LEFT, one right note, signature 'P', catchword
Exodus 4 plain scripture, VN LEFT, one right note; signature 'W 2'; topical RH at gutter
Exodus 26-27 chapter break: verses VN right, CHAP. XXVII, argument, 2-line initial, one long left note; catchword; topical RH at gutter (right)
Leviticus ANNOTATIONS leaf (the B copy of P_0288): whole body AN with lemma, left summaries, right citations; catchword 'CHAP.'
Leviticus 22-23 chapter break: VN LEFT, CHAP. XXIII, argument, 2-line initial, right notes with NUMBERED side-marks (1. 2.), right note beside the argument; signature 'Pp 2'
TITLE PAGE of the second tome: full four-sided type-ornament BORDER, display title in six type sizes, italic descriptive lines, motto, imprint, date; MS pen inscription across the top
APPROBATIO: woodcut CARTOUCHE headpiece with the title set INSIDE it, italic Latin prose (8-line woodcut initial N), MS library marks and stamps, three signatory entries; lower third blank

PSALTER (B copy): annotation tail (lemmas), 'PSALME II' head, argument with LEFT keyed notes, two-sort 'VV' initial, verses with INTERLEAVED italic glosses, LEFT lettered gloss-key column, right citations; catchword — no page number visible except '16' top-left

BOOK OPENING (Proverbs): ornament band, three-line BT, CHAP. I, argument with right note, woodcut initial, verses VN LEFT with letter-keyed glosses in a RIGHT key column; SHOW-THROUGH of the verso's ornament/title at top; signature 'Kk 3'
Lamentations 3-4 (B copy): verse-per-paragraph body, VN right, ACROSTIC letter column far right (italic Hebrew letter names), left notes, CHAP. IIII, 2-line initial; catchword 'It was'

HISTORICAL TABLE, four ruled columns (Anni mundi | Patriarches | The sacred Historie | Schismes and infidelitie), double-rule header, centred two-line AGE title mid-page, lettered date cells; lower right cells EMPTY
ENTIRELY BLANK LEAF — no type, no rule, no ornament, no marks; paper texture and a few foxing specks only
